design.protocol: Before patching, read the target file with sufficient surrounding context; avoid truncated lines and generated output. Use stable, narrow anchors and one conceptual hunk. If verification fails, do not guess: re-read the current file, inspect the diff/concurrent changes, and produce a new patch. Never use fuzzy matching or overwrite behavior.
